layers.name: Layer 1: Energy & Grid Infrastructure
layers.subtitle: The Physical Power & Thermal Foundation
layers.tagline: Without gigawatts of clean baseload power, compute is dead silicon.
layers.margin_profile: Regulated Utilities (10-12% ROE) / High Merchant Spreads ($80-$160/MWh)
layers.thesis: AI data centers require 24/7 continuous baseload power that intermittent wind and solar cannot guarantee alone. Nuclear power plants (restarts & SMRs), natural gas turbines with peaker capacity, and utility interconnect queues create multi-year pricing power for energy producers with existing grid connections.
key_bottlenecks: High-voltage substation transformer lead times (30 to 42 months)
Regional utility interconnection study queues (4 to 7 years in PJM and ERCOT)
Freshwater rights and thermal water discharge regulations for evaporative cooling
value_capture_drivers: Behind-the-meter nuclear Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) at premium fixed tariffs
Direct-to-chip liquid cooling (Vertiv, Schneider) replacing legacy air-cooled chillers
On-site microgrid generation (Bloom Energy fuel cells, gas turbines)

layers.name: Layer 2: Chips & Semiconductor Fabrication
layers.subtitle: The Compute Core & Memory Fabric
layers.tagline: Extreme physics barriers create global semiconductor monopolies.
layers.thesis: The law of silicon economics: every frontier model requires exponential FLOP scaling. Leading-edge foundries (TSMC), extreme ultraviolet lithography (ASML), and high-bandwidth memory (SK Hynix, Micron) enjoy near-insurmountable technological moats that absorb the lion's share of Big Tech CapEx.
key_bottlenecks: Advanced packaging capacity: TSMC CoWoS (Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate) wafer allocations
High Bandwidth Memory (HBM3e / HBM4) stacking yield and wafer supply
Sub-2nm EUV high-NA scanner deployment cadence
value_capture_drivers: NVIDIA full-stack CUDA software moat & NVLink inter-GPU cluster fabric
Custom ASIC acceleration (Broadcom co-design for Google TPU, AWS Trainium, Meta MTIA)
Silicon photonics and optical I/O replacing copper traces at high thermal density

layers.name: Layer 3: Cloud Infrastructure & AI Factories
layers.subtitle: The Scale, Neo-Cloud & Optical Cluster Layer
layers.tagline: Managing multi-hundred-megawatt AI factories with zero-packet-drop networking.
layers.thesis: Training and serving 100k+ GPU clusters requires ultra-low latency optical networking (800G/1.6T InfiniBand & Ultra Ethernet) and specialized neo-cloud infrastructure. Hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI) leverage balance sheets to finance gigawatt facilities, while specialized GPU clouds (CoreWeave, Lambda) win on bare-metal provisioning velocity.
key_bottlenecks: Ultra-dense power delivery (100kW+ per server rack)
800G / 1.6T optical transceivers and DSP supply constraints (Coherent, Lumentum)
Depreciation cycle mismatch: 3-year GPU obsolescence vs 20-year real estate
value_capture_drivers: Multi-cloud GPU virtualization and checkpointing orchestration
Arista / Cisco Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC) standard scaling

layers.name: Layer 4: Foundation Models & Frontier Labs
layers.subtitle: The Frontier Intelligence & Data Engine
layers.tagline: The race for Artificial General Intelligence, reasoning models, and frontier data curation.
layers.margin_profile: Negative Net Margins (Heavy Training R&D) / Rapidly Scaling API Run-rates
layers.thesis: Frontier labs create core reasoning and multimodal capabilities powered by massive pre-training clusters and specialized RLVR/RLHF data pipelines (Scale AI). The investment tension is between proprietary frontier models (OpenAI, Anthropic) capturing premium enterprise budgets vs open-weights models (Meta Llama, DeepSeek) commoditizing baseline completion.
key_bottlenecks: Pre-training compute cluster capital costs ($1B+ per next-gen model run)
High-quality human and synthetic reasoning data exhaustion (Post-training RLVR)
Inference token cost economics and latency for multi-step agentic reasoning
value_capture_drivers: Test-time compute scaling (System 2 thinking / RL with verifiable reward functions)
High-quality post-training data curation and RLHF pipelines (Scale AI)
Enterprise private model weights hosting with zero data-retention guarantees

layers.name: Layer 5: Applications & Agentic AI
layers.subtitle: The End-User Value Capture & Systems of Record Layer
layers.tagline: Replacing white-collar human labor budgets and creating vertical software monopolies.
layers.thesis: This is where the majority of end-user economic value will ultimately be realized. Winning applications combine proprietary enterprise data lakehouses (Databricks) and system-of-record ontology integration (Palantir, ServiceNow) with autonomous agentic workflows (Cursor, Devin). Defensibility comes from deep workflow integration and outcome-based pricing.
key_bottlenecks: High customer acquisition cost (CAC) in crowded commodity wrapper categories
System-of-record integration friction and data governance hurdles
Enterprise security, compliance, and hallucination liability
value_capture_drivers: Autonomous AI coding and domain agents disrupting $500B software/professional labor
System-of-record workflow moats and enterprise data lakehouses (Palantir AIP, Databricks, ServiceNow)
Outcome-based pricing models replacing per-seat software licenses
